title: The rise of Royal Enfield Bomber GT : Holy Shift : Episode 2 : PowerDrift
description: With hardly four days to go, Harsha and Rohith need to buckle up and get on with their Royal Enfield custom build. But an argument over the paint job of the Continental GT gets team Holy Shift embroiled in a race. Will they be able to finish the Bomber GT project on time, or will Rohan have the last laugh?  #PowerDrift   Join the 1 Million strong #PDArmy : http://bit.ly/PDARMY Stay updated with News, Behind the Scenes here : https://www.instagram.com/powerdrift/ Tee Shirts, Badges & More official merchandise : http://www.powerdrift.com/merchandise Find us on Facebook: http://facebook.com/POWERDRIFTOFFICIAL/ Follow us on Twitter for Launch updates & more : https://twitter.com/PD_Official

asr.full_text: Welcome back to the second episode at HoliShift. I know, I missed ya'll too! But before we dive in, let's take a look at what happened in the first episode. Did an awesome pain job on my bike. Stumbled upon Rohit at the bar and he made fun of us. I'd think he was drunk. Rohit came up with the design and a two tone paint scheme. We had to do some fabrication. I come with an even better paint scheme drunk Rohit came up with the design and two tone paint scheme We had to do some fabrication I come up with an even better paint scheme And Rohit gets all b****y I challenge the crybaby to a race Winner gets to choose So what is it gonna be The sober, two toned fighter plane or the retarded shark themed Bomber! It was a no-brainer that I would win the race. Come on, it's pretty obvious. Every victory demands a few mandatory victory donuts, right? See, just because this guy lost this race, he wants to do another drift contest and apparently the winner of that will have the final say, because it's not about who's the fastest, but who's the smartest. Smartest my ass. I was pretty confident I'd own his class at this as well, so I lined up for the drift battle. But all those victory doughnuts were a little too much for my go-kart, which eventually gave up and.. died on me.. Excuses, excuses! It was MY turn to show the noob how it was done. Liar! ROF-ing! LMAO! A.I.V. R.I.P. Lol, where is your weapon? El male! So basically what happened is. I got to beat Mr. Rohit a Rvaryan Auto Ninja in a drift contest! So what? What do we do now? Ok so now how are you gonna take my design forward? So yeah, for your design what we are going to do is we are going to take your existing tank strip it down of all of its existing paint, bring it down to a nice bare metal finish and yeah, that's basically... Dude, wait what about the shark theme? Aight fine, for the shark theme, what I was planning on doing is, giving it some eyes, some teeth, some basic shark motif. I love the bare metal finish of the tank but the metal would rust within a matter of days... if it were left like this. So what we are going to do is, mimic the look of brushed metal. But first the few coats of Epoxy. but the metal would rust after a matter a days if I was left like this So what we are going to do is, mimic the look of brushed metal but first, a few coats of epoxy we sprayed the whole tank, with two different shades of metallic silver and then comes the painstaking yet fun part, the masking The paint job looks amazing. I don't know why everyone else has other statement.. ..to make about my creative abilities. This is the last leg of a 7 day long rollercoaster ride.. ..of a build. When we made the design.. ..we went across a lot of stuff and we have seen. There are lots of things to be done.. ..but we must be careful. Everybody has some more other statement to make about my creative abilities This is the last leg of a 7 day long roller coaster ride of a build Today , we assemble the bomber GT and hopefully reveal it to Rohan And in an instant, this will be our new vehicle! This is going to be our new exhaust. If this doesn't inconvenience Arshya's neighbours I don't know what will So we're done What do you think? It's okay come on say it out Tell me this looks insane Did I tell you bro What do you think? How do you do? Look at this. So much. So what? We got the car, right? We got the house. We got that entire house in a day. So what are you doing here? What are you doing? We were having lunch. And then we had my plan. We are not going to go back that way in a day. But we'll do. So. So what? We are not going back. I don't want you to leave me. I love you. I just want to go back. The Bomber GT might look like a basic build, but it was no walk in the park for us, this being the first build at Holy Shift & All. So this is how much it cost to build. Fabrication set us back by 5000 rupees. The paint job cost us 16500 rupees, the upholstery amounted to 3100 rupees and the bike was in desperate need of a rear tyre, thanks to all the burnouts you saw in the previous episode and that's 3400 rupees there. We didn't have to spend a lot on parts though because we found most of them at M86 itself, so let's say we borrowed them, without permission. Now, the consumables like the oil, brake pads and other stuff took another 3800 rupees from our budget. Finally, the labour, let's say that was priceless. The Bomber GT, as you see it cost us around 31,800 rupees. Not bad, right? Oh, watch me now Alright, this guy is not gonna stop. Roll the credits man. Yo Akash, start that shoot. No no no no no no. Not this one, not this one. It's too fast. The other one. Yeah yeah, that's the one. Smack the baby's ass, live it crying in the cradle I'm not stable, but more than f***ing able Undermine anybody, tryna bring it to the table My skinny hands could whip anybody's ass My silly rap is faster than Jackie Chan on crack I wanted an exciting job and he gave me this day but I just died I wish every son of a b***h respected what's religion Vanquish every sorry ass, he the Noah demon Muslim or a Christian, Hindu or a Buddhist No priest or a nudist, no f***ing notice I who tell everybody I can be slayed I who ascend in ways and can be slaved I have slayed several demons with roboblades And the suede from the path of the spirit I am some next-level shit This is real life, we call it Holy Shift Ooh, representing
